state_contract.revision_rule: Every successful state-changing command advances the monotonic page context revision.
state_contract.deictic_rule: A context-bound command must reject execution when its captured context_revision is stale.

commands.effect: open a mode/view and optional deep-link focus
show search results in the inspector
select an object present in the active view

commands.availability: path start and distinct selected node
selected projection edge; aggregate cluster relations are excluded
commands.effect: show alternative paths while excluding that edge

shared_actuation_rule: Human UI handlers and WebMCP tools invoke this same command registry.
authority_limit: Commands may change browser presentation state but never ToS source, review, rights, or canon state.
